eventVenues: Martin Marietta Center for the Performing Arts
raleigh-nc.blurb: Raleigh anchors the Research Triangle, so its event calendar leans on tech, life sciences, state government and university conferences, alongside a busy wedding market spread between downtown venues and countryside estates. Spring and fall bring mild weather and blooming or turning trees, while humid summer afternoons often call for early or golden-hour outdoor sessions.

conferenceVenues: Omaha Marriott Downtown at the Capitol District
Embassy Suites by Hilton Omaha La Vista Hotel & Conference Center
eventVenues: Omaha's Henry Doorly Zoo and Aquarium
photoSpots: Gene Leahy Mall at The RiverFront
omaha-ne.blurb: Omaha draws insurance, finance, rail and agribusiness meetings, and it hosts the annual Berkshire Hathaway shareholders meeting and the NCAA Men's College World Series. Winters are cold and snowy, so many weddings and outdoor shoots cluster between May and October, with indoor museum and ballroom venues carrying the off-season.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Miami and James L. Knight Center
eventVenues: Adrienne Arsht Center for the Performing Arts
miami-fl.blurb: Miami's calendar is shaped by international business, finance, art and hospitality, with Art Basel Miami Beach each December and a steady run of Latin American corporate meetings and destination weddings. The dry season from roughly November to April is peak time for events; summer brings heat, humidity, daily storms and hurricane-season planning.

oakland-ca.blurb: Oakland's events mix tech and nonprofit gatherings, arts and music happenings, and weddings that take advantage of historic theaters, gardens and the hills above the city. The climate is mild year-round with drier, sunnier days than San Francisco, though morning fog and a rainy season from about November to March are worth building into shoot plans.

minneapolis-mn.blurb: Minneapolis is home to major retail, healthcare, medical device and financial companies, which keeps its convention center and downtown hotels busy with corporate meetings and trade events. Summers are short and lush with the city's lakes and riverfront at their best, while long, cold winters push most events indoors to converted warehouses, museums and ballrooms.

eventVenues: Tulsa Garden Center at Woodward Park
tulsa-ok.blurb: Tulsa's meetings market grew out of the energy and aerospace industries, and the city now pairs those with arts events, music venues and weddings in its Art Deco downtown. Spring and fall offer the most comfortable outdoor conditions, while summers are hot and spring storms can force quick changes to outdoor plans.

conferenceVenues: Century II Performing Arts & Convention Center
wichita-ks.airport: Wichita Dwight D. Eisenhower National Airport (ICT)
wichita-ks.blurb: Known as the Air Capital of the World, Wichita hosts many aviation and manufacturing meetings, plus regional association events and a steady local wedding scene. Outdoor work is most comfortable in spring and fall; summers are hot and windy, and spring brings severe-weather risk.

photoSpots: City Park and the Besthoff Sculpture Garden
new-orleans-la.airport: Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY)
new-orleans-la.blurb: New Orleans is a major convention city and hosts large festivals such as Mardi Gras, Jazz Fest and Essence Festival, plus destination weddings with second-line parades through historic streets. The most comfortable season runs from late fall through spring; summers are hot and humid with frequent afternoon storms, and hurricane season runs June through November.

conferenceVenues: Loews Arlington Hotel and Convention Center
photoSpots: University of Texas at Arlington campus
arlington-tx.blurb: Arlington sits between Dallas and Fort Worth and is best known for its entertainment district, home to AT&T Stadium, Globe Life Field and Six Flags Over Texas, which draws major sporting events, concerts and corporate hospitality. Spring and fall are the sweet spots for outdoor sessions, since North Texas summers regularly run past 100°F.

conferenceVenues: Cleveland Marriott Downtown at Key Tower
cleveland-oh.blurb: Cleveland's event scene is tied to healthcare, manufacturing and higher education, with the Cleveland Clinic and University Circle institutions generating a steady stream of medical and academic meetings. Lake Erie brings pleasant summers and colorful falls but snowy, gray winters, so indoor museum and historic hotel venues are popular from November to March.

conferenceVenues: Dignity Health Theater and Convention Center
Bakersfield Marriott at the Convention Center
bakersfield-ca.blurb: Bakersfield's economy runs on agriculture and energy, and the city is known for the country-music Bakersfield Sound, which shows up in venues like Buck Owens' Crystal Palace. Summers are very hot and dry, so outdoor shoots work best in spring and fall or near sunrise and sunset, and winter can bring tule fog.

conferenceVenues: Hilton Hawaiian Village Waikiki Beach Resort
Hyatt Regency Waikiki Beach Resort and Spa
eventVenues: The Royal Hawaiian, a Luxury Collection Resort
Moana Surfrider, A Westin Resort & Spa
photoSpots: Magic Island at Ala Moana Beach Park
honolulu-hi.blurb: Honolulu draws Pacific Rim business meetings, military and government events, incentive trips and a large share of destination weddings. The weather is warm year-round, with trade winds and passing showers, and winter months bring bigger surf on the north and west shores while sunset timing makes beachfront shoots popular any season.

tampa-fl.blurb: Tampa hosts healthcare, defense, finance and sports-related events, along with large Gasparilla celebrations each winter and a busy year-round wedding market. Winter and spring are the most comfortable months for outdoor sessions; summers bring heat, humidity and near-daily afternoon thunderstorms during hurricane season.

aurora-co.blurb: Aurora sits next to Denver International Airport and is home to the Anschutz Medical Campus and several military installations, making it a regular host for medical, aerospace and large association conventions. The high-plains climate brings plenty of sun and dramatic mountain views on clear days, with summer afternoon storms and occasional heavy spring snow to plan around.

anaheim-ca.blurb: Anaheim's convention center is the largest on the West Coast, and the surrounding resort district keeps it busy with trade shows such as the NAMM Show and Natural Products Expo West. Southern California's mild, dry weather allows outdoor shoots most of the year, with the coolest, greenest conditions in winter and spring.

conferenceVenues: Avenue of the Arts Costa Mesa (South Coast Metro)
santa-ana-ca.blurb: As Orange County's seat, Santa Ana hosts government, legal and cultural events, and its museums and historic downtown are popular for galas and weddings with a strong Latino cultural influence. The mild coastal-inland climate makes outdoor shoots possible most of the year, with summer heat and late-spring marine-layer mornings to plan around.

photoSpots: Harbor Bridge views from North Beach
corpus-christi-tx.blurb: Corpus Christi's events are tied to its port, energy and petrochemical industries, naval presence and Gulf Coast tourism, and beach and bayfront weddings are common. Winters are mild and good for outdoor shoots, while summers are hot and humid with steady coastal winds and a June-to-November hurricane season.

conferenceVenues: Marriott Riverside at the Convention Center
eventVenues: The Cheech Marin Center for Chicano Art & Culture
photoSpots: Mission Inn and Downtown Main Street Mall
riverside-ca.blurb: Riverside's event scene centers on its historic downtown, where the Mission Inn hosts weddings and its Festival of Lights draws crowds each holiday season, while the university and county government bring steady meetings. Inland Empire summers are hot and dry, so spring, fall and winter offer the best outdoor light and comfort.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency St. Louis at The Arch
eventVenues: St. Louis Union Station Grand Hall
photoSpots: Forest Park and the World's Fair Pavilion
st-louis-mo.blurb: St. Louis hosts healthcare, bioscience, agriculture-tech and financial-services meetings, along with large faith-based and sports events, and its historic buildings and gardens are favorite wedding backdrops. Spring and fall are the best seasons for outdoor work; summers are hot and humid and winters can be cold and gray.

conferenceVenues: Griffin Gate Marriott Golf Resort & Spa
eventVenues: The Arboretum, State Botanical Garden of Kentucky
lexington-fayette-ky.blurb: Lexington's events revolve around the thoroughbred industry, bourbon tourism and the University of Kentucky, with Keeneland's April and October race meets drawing major corporate hospitality. Horse farms with stone fences and rolling pastures are common wedding and portrait settings, at their greenest in spring and most colorful in October.

eventVenues: Morris Chapel at University of the Pacific
stockton-ca.blurb: Stockton sits on the San Joaquin Delta and draws agriculture, logistics and education events, with nearby Lodi wineries adding to the region's wedding options. Summers are hot and dry with cooling Delta breezes in the evening, and winter can bring Central Valley tule fog.

eventVenues: Carnegie Museum of Art and Natural History
pittsburgh-pa.blurb: Pittsburgh's event calendar draws on healthcare, robotics, AI and higher education, with Carnegie Mellon, Pitt and UPMC fueling a steady stream of conferences. The city's rivers, bridges and hills give it varied backdrops; fall foliage is a highlight, while winters are cold and often overcast.

conferenceVenues: William A. Egan Civic and Convention Center
anchorage-ak.blurb: Anchorage hosts oil and gas, aviation, military and Alaska Native organization meetings, and summer destination weddings with mountain and inlet views. Long summer daylight gives photographers extended golden hours, while winter days are short and cold, so outdoor shoot windows shift dramatically by season.

cincinnati-oh.blurb: Cincinnati is headquarters to Procter & Gamble, Kroger and other major firms, so consumer-goods, retail and financial meetings fill its convention center and downtown hotels. Historic architecture in Over-the-Rhine and along the Ohio River makes for strong backdrops, with spring and fall the most comfortable outdoor seasons.

conferenceVenues: Delta Hotels by Marriott Ashland Downtown
ironville-ky.blurb: Ironville is a Boyd County community on the edge of Ashland, so most events here draw on the Ashland and Huntington, WV, tri-state area, from healthcare and industrial meetings to weddings in historic downtown venues. The Ohio River valley has four distinct seasons, with spring blooms and fall foliage in the surrounding hills offering the best outdoor conditions.

conferenceVenues: Delta Hotels by Marriott Ashland Downtown
meads-ky.blurb: Meads is a small Boyd County community just outside Ashland, and local events typically use venues in Ashland and across the river in the Huntington, WV, area. Spring and fall are the most reliable seasons for outdoor sessions in the wooded hills of northeastern Kentucky, with humid summers and occasional winter snow.

The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa
Hilton Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa
eventVenues: Green Valley Ranch Resort Spa and Casino
The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa
photoSpots: Ethel M Chocolates Botanical Cactus Garden
henderson-nv.blurb: Henderson offers a quieter, resort-style alternative to the Las Vegas Strip, with lakeside and casino resorts hosting corporate retreats, incentive groups and weddings. Desert conditions mean very hot summers, so outdoor shoots are best planned for fall through spring or at sunrise and sunset.

eventVenues: Steven Tanger Center for the Performing Arts
greensboro-nc.blurb: Greensboro's history in textiles and its role in the 1960 sit-in movement shape its cultural events, while its coliseum complex and several universities draw tournaments, trade shows and academic meetings. Spring and fall are prime seasons for outdoor work, with mild winters and warm, humid summers.

eventVenues: Marjorie McNeely Conservatory at Como Park
saint-paul-mn.blurb: As Minnesota's capital, Saint Paul hosts government, association and healthcare meetings, along with the Saint Paul Winter Carnival and the nearby Minnesota State Fair. Victorian homes, river bluffs and historic downtown buildings make strong backdrops, with summer and fall best for outdoor sessions and indoor venues favored through the cold winter.

conferenceVenues: Renaissance Dallas at Plano Legacy West Hotel
Dallas/Plano Marriott at Legacy Town Center
photoSpots: Oak Point Park and Nature Preserve
plano-tx.blurb: Plano is home to the corporate headquarters of companies such as Toyota North America and JCPenney, which keeps its Legacy business district busy with corporate meetings and product events. North Texas weather favors spring and fall for outdoor shoots, as summers are very hot and spring brings storm risk.

eventVenues: Cathedral Basilica of the Sacred Heart
photoSpots: Cathedral Basilica of the Sacred Heart
newark-nj.blurb: Newark combines insurance, logistics, higher education and arts institutions, so its venues host corporate meetings, university events and performances within easy reach of Manhattan. Branch Brook Park's cherry blossoms make April a standout month for outdoor portraits, while summers are hot and winters cold.

eventVenues: Toledo Museum of Art and Glass Pavilion
toledo-oh.blurb: Toledo is known as the Glass City for its glassmaking heritage, and its convention center, art museum and riverfront host manufacturing, automotive and regional association events. Summer and early fall are best for outdoor shoots along the Maumee River, while winters are cold with lake-effect clouds.

lincoln-ne.blurb: Lincoln's event calendar is driven by state government, the University of Nebraska and Husker football weekends, which fill hotels each fall. Spring and fall bring the most comfortable outdoor weather, while summers are hot and winters cold and windy.

eventVenues: Dr. Phillips Center for the Performing Arts
Albin Polasek Museum & Sculpture Gardens (Winter Park)
orlando-fl.blurb: Orlando is one of the country's busiest convention destinations, with the Orange County Convention Center and theme-park resorts hosting trade shows, incentive trips and destination weddings year-round. Winter and spring are the most comfortable months for outdoor sessions; summers bring heat, humidity and near-daily afternoon thunderstorms.

chula-vista-ca.blurb: Chula Vista's bayfront became a major meetings destination with the 2025 opening of the Gaylord Pacific Resort & Convention Center, adding large-scale conference space to the South Bay. The coastal climate is mild year-round, with late-spring marine layer mornings and dependably clear fall days for outdoor work.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Jersey City on the Hudson
eventVenues: Hyatt Regency Jersey City on the Hudson
Canopy by Hilton Jersey City Arts District
jersey-city-nj.blurb: Jersey City's waterfront financial district hosts banking, insurance and tech meetings with the Manhattan skyline as a backdrop, and Liberty State Park is a favorite for wedding portraits facing the Statue of Liberty. Spring and fall offer the best outdoor light and comfort, with hot summers and cold, windy waterfront winters.

conferenceVenues: Sheraton Grand at Wild Horse Pass
eventVenues: Sheraton Grand at Wild Horse Pass
photoSpots: Historic Downtown Chandler and Dr. A.J. Chandler Park
chandler-az.blurb: Chandler is a semiconductor and tech hub in the Phoenix area, with Intel's large campus and the Price Corridor generating corporate meetings and product events. Outdoor shoots are best from October through April, since summer temperatures regularly top 105°F and the monsoon season adds dust storms and lightning.

conferenceVenues: Hilton Fort Wayne at the Grand Wayne Convention Center
fort-wayne-in.blurb: Fort Wayne's economy rests on manufacturing, healthcare, insurance and defense, and its revitalized riverfront downtown draws regional conferences, festivals and weddings. Summers are warm and green with the Lakeside rose garden in bloom from June, while winters are cold and snowy.

conferenceVenues: Hyatt Regency Buffalo Hotel and Conference Center
eventVenues: Buffalo and Erie County Botanical Gardens
buffalo-ny.blurb: Buffalo's architectural legacy, from Frank Lloyd Wright houses to Olmsted parks, shapes its event scene alongside healthcare, education and advanced manufacturing meetings. Summers along the waterfront are pleasant and popular for weddings, while lake-effect snow makes indoor venues the norm in winter.

durham-nc.blurb: Durham's events draw on Duke University, Duke Health and nearby Research Triangle Park, with converted tobacco warehouses now serving as venues for conferences, galas and weddings. Spring blooms at Duke Gardens and mild fall weather are peak times for outdoor sessions, while summers are hot and humid.

conferenceVenues: The Vinoy Resort & Golf Club, Autograph Collection
eventVenues: Museum of Fine Arts, St. Petersburg
James Museum of Western & Wildlife Art
st-petersburg-fl.blurb: St. Petersburg pairs a museum-rich downtown waterfront with Gulf beaches, making it a draw for association meetings, arts events and destination weddings. Winter and spring offer comfortable, drier weather and clear sunsets, while summer brings heat, afternoon storms and hurricane-season planning.

conferenceVenues: Beckman Center of the National Academies of Sciences & Engineering
irvine-ca.blurb: Irvine is a master-planned business hub with tech, biotech, automotive and gaming companies, plus UC Irvine, so corporate meetings and offsites make up much of its event calendar. Mild Southern California weather allows outdoor shoots nearly year-round, with spring green hills and clear fall days the best windows.

eventVenues: Republic of the Rio Grande Museum
photoSpots: Lake Casa Blanca International State Park
laredo-tx.blurb: Laredo is one of the busiest land ports on the U.S.-Mexico border, so trade, logistics and customs-related meetings anchor its business events, and the George Washington's Birthday Celebration is a signature winter tradition. Summers are very hot, so outdoor sessions are best from late fall through early spring.

eventVenues: Buddy Holly Hall of Performing Arts and Sciences
photoSpots: Buddy and Maria Elena Holly Plaza
lubbock-tx.blurb: Lubbock's event scene is driven by Texas Tech University, agriculture, cotton and the growing High Plains wine industry, with the Depot District offering music and nightlife venues. Wide skies make for long sunsets, but spring winds and dust and hot summer afternoons favor early-morning or evening outdoor sessions.

conferenceVenues: Monona Terrace Community and Convention Center
madison-wi.blurb: As Wisconsin's capital and home of the University of Wisconsin-Madison, the city hosts government, academic, healthcare-tech and association events, with Epic Systems in nearby Verona adding a major corporate presence. The isthmus between two lakes is at its best in summer and early fall, while winters are long and cold.
